media.alt_text: A volunteer firefighter shares insights from 13 years in the brigade.

posts.text: Fire and Emergency New Zealand @FireEmergencyNZ Jun 18, 2023 It’s Te Wiki Tūao ā-Motu – National Volunteer Week and we are thanking our amazing volunteers and everyone who supports them for their incredible contributions to communities across Aotearoa. Please join us in saying thank you! #NVW2023
